'''Delacrix''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located within the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Originally known as '''Duinihiim''', it was absorbed into [[Xim's empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]].<ref name="TEA" /> Histories of the planet talked about the ancient [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], previous to their [[Hutt Cataclysms|civil war]], with horror and fear. During the [[Fourth Pius Dea Crusade]], the [[Pius Dea]]-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched assaults on Delacrix and other planets to the north of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
